20 Students , One Sound.
The Sitar Students render a concerto version of the Aarti Om Jai Jagadish Hare taught by Guru Pandit Kartick Kumar as their invocation prayer. Pandit Kartick Kumar used to always play this tune first, before playing the Sitar. He informed the Sitar Students too to do the same.
With devotion the Students bring together this beautiful Instrumental Aarti.
The Foundation Room Student : Ms. Punam Rani leads the group of Students from the Music Instrumental Department of Panchkula College, University KUK
Special thanks to Panchkula College
